# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/subscription

Check if the current user is watching a repo

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-196`

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**200** — WatchInfo

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `subscribed` | bool | Whether the repository is being watched |
| `ignored` | bool | Whether notifications are ignored |
| `reason` | any | Reason for watch status |
| `created_at` | time.Time | When the watch was created |
| `url` | string | URL for managing watch status |
| `repository_url` | string | URL of the repository |
